item.hbs_boomseed.boom_seed.lore: Small seeds that pack a big BOOM. So big that some blocks may be destroyed entirely. Right click to throw.
item.hbs_boomseed.great_boom_seed.lore: Large seed for an even bigger BOOM. Right click to throw.
block.hbs_boomseed.sunjump_flower.lore: Right click this flower on some soft soil to JUMP into the air. Only blooms with sufficient light. Can be crafted into seeds.
